description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLeaveAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides an API endpoint to retrieve employee leave data, including filtering, sorting, and pagination. The class extends Endpoint and implements CollectionEndpoint, utilizing traits for authorization and leave request services. It includes methods for fetching all leaves with query parameters, and unimplemented stubs for create and delete operations.
